headline: Lower Gold Prices Trigger Physical Shortages and Dealer Premiums in Karachi
summary: Declining gold prices led to heavy investor purchases in Karachi, triggering a shortage of physical bullion bars. Local jewellers and bullion dealers charged premiums of Rs10,000 to Rs30,000 per tola due to excess demand.
why: Karachi is Pakistan's main financial center and precious metal distribution center. Domestic physical bullion premiums reflect retail hedging against currency depreciation and structural supply imbalances.
